answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is bonded identity with slashing: every voting agent must lock collateral, so each extra puppet identity costs real capital, and peers who prove collusion get that stake burned. A marble registry records which identities carry bonded weight, and long honest histories echo forward as reputation multipliers, while fresh wallets start near zero influence. Auditors flag suspicious clusters with a violet mark for review. Attack cost grows per identity while honest agents stake once, so mass sybils stop being profitable.
